verses.text: [A Psalm] of David when he feigned madness before Abimelech, who drove him away and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.textZh: （大衛在亞比米勒面前裝瘋，被他趕出去，就作這詩。）我要時時稱頌耶和華；讚美他的話必常在我口中。

verses.text: My soul will make its boast in the LORD; The humble will hear it and rejoice.
verses.textZh: 我的心必因耶和華誇耀；謙卑人聽見就要喜樂。

verses.text: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.
verses.textZh: 你們和我當稱耶和華為大，一同高舉他的名。

verses.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
verses.textZh: 我曾尋求耶和華，他就應允我，救我脫離了一切的恐懼。

verses.text: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces will never be ashamed.
verses.textZh: 凡仰望他的，便有光榮；他們的臉必不蒙羞。

verses.text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him And saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.textZh: 我這困苦人呼求，耶和華便垂聽，救我脫離一切患難。

verses.text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, And rescues them.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的使者在敬畏他的人四圍安營，搭救他們。

verses.text: O taste and see that the LORD is good; How blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
verses.textZh: 你們要嘗嘗主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善；投靠他的人有福了！

verses.text: O fear the LORD, you His saints; For to those who fear Him there is no want.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們當敬畏他，因敬畏他的一無所缺。

verses.text: The young lions do lack and suffer hunger; But they who seek the LORD shall not be in want of any good thing.
verses.textZh: 少壯獅子還缺食忍餓，但尋求耶和華的甚麼好處都不缺。

verses.text: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 眾弟子啊，你們當來聽我的話！我要將敬畏耶和華的道教訓你們。

verses.text: Who is the man who desires life And loves [length of] days that he may see good?
verses.textZh: 有何人喜好存活，愛慕長壽，得享美福，

verses.text: Keep your tongue from evil And your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.textZh: 就要禁止舌頭不出惡言，嘴唇不說詭詐的話。

verses.text: Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textZh: 要離惡行善，尋求和睦，一心追趕。

verses.text: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous And His ears are [open] to their cry.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人；他的耳朵聽他們的呼求。

verses.text: The face of the LORD is against evildoers, To cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.textZh: 耶和華向行惡的人變臉，要從世上除滅他們的名號。

verses.text: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD hears And delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.textZh: 義人呼求，耶和華聽見了，便救他們脫離一切患難。

verses.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verses.textZh: 耶和華靠近傷心的人，拯救靈性痛悔的人。

verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, But the LORD delivers him out of them all.
verses.textZh: 義人多有苦難，但耶和華救他脫離這一切，

verses.text: He keeps all his bones, Not one of them is broken.
verses.textZh: 又保全他一身的骨頭，連一根也不折斷。

verses.text: Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
verses.textZh: 惡必害死惡人；恨惡義人的，必被定罪。

verses.text: The LORD redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
verses.textZh: 耶和華救贖他僕人的靈魂；凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
